details:
It appears after this latest update, any videos on quest seem to be completely broken. They are getting stuck in a perpetual state of forever-loading. I've had multiple creators bring up Quest playback failures to me.
The presence of this issue was confirmed with a world uploaded with the latest SDK from this build.
Please remedy asap.
